import json, sys, os
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/site'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
import ref as R

def release(mid='m', mode='range', nclusters=2, packet_limit=3, idle=10, width=2):
    disc = []
    vals0 = [1515,1614,1414,1515,1515,1515]
    act0  = [0,10,10,0,0,0]
    vals1 = [1515,1814,1314,1515,1515,1515]
    n = 4 if nclusters >= 2 else 2
    for i in range(n):
        if i % 2 == 0:
            disc.append({'class':0,'values':list(vals0),'activation':list(act0)})
        else:
            disc.append({'class':1,'values':list(vals1),'activation':list(act0)})
    extra = []
    if nclusters >= 3:
        # a third cluster: class 0, length 3 (width must be >= 3)
        w = max(width,3)
        v3 = [1515,1614,1414,1614,1515,1515,1515]
        a3 = [0,10,10,10,0,0,0]
        extra = [{'class':0,'values':list(v3),'activation':list(a3)},
                 {'class':0,'values':list(v3),'activation':list(a3)}]
        disc = disc + extra
        width = w
    return {'id':mid,'classes':2,'width':width,
            'eps':[1,1],'ratio':[0,1],'threshold':[1,1],'mode':mode,
            'packet_limit':packet_limit,'idle_us':idle,
            'discovery':disc,
            'train':[{'class':0,'values':[1614,1414]},{'class':1,'values':[1814,1314]}],
            'validation':[{'class':0,'values':[1614,1414]},{'class':1,'values':[1814,1314]}]}

def run(name, req):
    expected = R.ref_execute(req)
    from pipeline import execute
    try:
        got = execute(req)
    except Exception as exc:
        got = {'error':'invalid_request'}
    a = json.dumps(got,sort_keys=True); b = json.dumps(expected,sort_keys=True)
    if a == b:
        print('OK  ', name, '->', json.dumps(got)[:220])
    else:
        print('FAIL', name)
        print('  got', a[:800]); print('  exp', b[:800])
    return a == b
